ar: أللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ لا يَرْغَبُ فِي الْجَزَاءِ،
en: O God, O He who desires no repayment!
O He who shows no remorse at bestowal!

ar: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يُكَافِئُ عَبْدَهُ عَلَى السَّوآءِ،
en: O He who rewards not His servant tit for tat!
Thy kindness is a new beginning, Thy pardon gratuitous bounty,
Thy punishment justice, Thy decree a choice for the best!

ar: إنْ أَعْطَيْتَ لَمْ تَشُبْ عَطَآءَكَ بِمَنٍّ،
en: If Thou bestowest, Thou stainest not Thy bestowal with obligation,

ar: وَإنْ مَنَعْتَ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَنْعُكَ تَعَدِّيا
en: and if Thou withholdest, Thou withholdest not in transgression.

ar: تَشْكُرُ مَنْ شَكَرَكَ وَأَنْتَ أَلْهَمْتَهُ شُكْرَكَ،
en: Thou showest gratitude to him who thanks Thee, while Thou hast inspired him to thank Thee.

ar: وَتُكَافِئُ مَنْ حَمِدَكَ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّمْتَهُ حَمْدَكَ،
en: Thou rewardest him who praises Thee, while though Thou hast taught him Thy praise.

ar: تَسْتُرُ عَلَى مَنْ لَوْ شِئْتَ فَضَحْتَهُ
en: Thou coverest him whom, if Thou willed, Thou wouldst expose,

ar: وَتَجُودُ عَلَى مَنْ لَوْ شِئْتَ مَنَعْتَهُ،
en: and Thou art generous toward him from whom, if Thou willed, Thou wouldst withhold.
Both are worthy of Thy exposure and withholding,

ar: غَيْرَ أَنَّكَ بَنَيْتَ أَفْعَالَكَ عَلَى التَّفَضُّلِ،
en: but Thou hast founded Thy acts upon gratuitous bounty,
channelled Thy power into forbearance,
received him who disobeyed Thee with clemency,
and disregarded him who intended wrongdoing against himself.

ar: تَسْتَنْظِرُهُمْ بِأناتِكَ إلى الإنَابَةِ وَتَتْرُكُ مُعَاجَلَتَهُمْ إلَى التَّوْبَةِ
en: Thou awaitest their turning back without haste and refrainest from rushing them toward repentance,
so that the perisher among them may not perish because of Thee
and the wretched may not be wretched through Thy favour,
but only after Thy prolonged excusing him
and successive arguments against him,
as an act of generosity through Thy pardon, O Generous,
and an act of kindliness through Thy tenderness, O Clement!
It is Thou who hast opened for Thy servants a door
to Thy pardon, which Thou hast named 'repentance'.

ar: وَجَعَلْتَ عَلَى ذلِكَ البَابِ دَلِيلاً مِنْ وَحْيِكَ
en: Thou hast placed upon that door a pointer from Thy revelation,

ar: لِئَلاَّ يَضِلُّوا عَنْهُ فَقُلْتَ تَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ :
en: lest they stray from it: Thou hast said (blessed is Thy Name),

ar: (تُوبُوا إلَى الله تَوْبَةً نَصُوحاً عَسَى رَبُّكُمْ
en: "Repent toward God with unswerving repentance! It may be that Thy Lord
will acquit of your evil deeds and will admit you into
gardens beneath which rivers flow,
upon the day when God will not degrade the Prophet

ar: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَى بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِمْ
en: and those who have faith along with him, their light running before them and on their right hands,

ar: يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا
en: and they say: 'Our Lord, complete for us our light, and forgive us!
Surely Thou art powerful over everything" (66:8).

ar: فَمَا عُذْرُ مَنْ أَغْفَلَ دُخُولَ ذلِكَ الْمَنْزِلِ
en: What is the excuse of him who remains heedless of entering that house
after the opening of the door and the setting up of the pointer?

ar: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي زِدْتَ فِي السَّوْمِ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ لِعِبَادِكَ
en: It is Thou who hast raised the price against Thyself to the advantage of Thy servants,
desiring their profit in their trade with Thee,
their triumph through reaching Thee, and their increase on account of Thee,
for Thou hast said (blessed is Thy Name and high art Thou exalted),
"Whoso brings a good deed shall have ten the like of it,

ar: وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَلاَ يُجْزى إلاّ مِثْلَهَا)
en: and whoso brings an evil deed shall only be recompensed the like of it" (6:160).

ar: وَقُلْتَ: (مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنْفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ الله كَمَثَلِ حَبَّة
en: Thou hast said, "The likeness of those who expend their wealth in the way of God is as the likeness of a grain of corn

ar: أَنْبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ فِي كُلِّ سُنْبُلَة مَائَةُ حَبَّة
en: that sprouts seven ears, in every ear a hundred grains;
so God multiplies unto whom He wills" (2:261).

ar: وَقُلْتَ: (مَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْ يُقْرِضُ الله قَرْضاً حَسَنَاً
en: Thou hast said, "Who is he that will lend to God a good loan,
and He will multiply it for him manifold" (2:245)?

ar: وَمَا أَنْزَلْتَ مِنْ نَظَائِرِهِنَّ فِي الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ تَضَاعِيفِ الْحَسَنَاتِ،
en: And Thou hast sent down in the Qur'an similar verses on the multiplying of good deeds.

ar: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي دَلَلْتَهُمْ بِقَوْلِكَ مِنْ غَيْبِكَ وَتَرْغِيْبِكَ
en: It is Thou who hast pointed them through Thy speech from Thy Unseen and Thy encouragement

ar: الَّذِي فِيهِ حَظُّهُمْ عَلَى مَا لَوْ سَتَرْتَهُ عَنْهُمْ
en: in which lies their good fortune toward that which - hadst Thou covered it from them

ar: لَمْ تُدْرِكْهُ أَبْصَارُهُمْ وَلَمْ تَعِـهِ أَسْمَاعُهُمْ
en: their eyes would not have perceived, their ears would not have heard,
and their imaginations would not have grasped,

ar: فَقُلْتَ: (اذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِيْ وَلا تَكْفُرُونِ)
en: for Thou hast said, "Remember Me and I will remember you be thankful to Me, and be you not thankless towards Me" (2:152)!
Thou hast said, "If you are thankful, surely I will increase you,
but if you are thankless, My chastisement is surely terrible" (14:7);
And Thou hast said, "Supplicate Me and I will respond to you,
surely those who wax too proud to worship Me
shall enter Gehenna utterly abject" (40:60).
Hence Thou hast named supplicating Thee 'worship' and refraining from it 'waxing proud',

ar: وَتَوَعَّدْتَ عَلَى تَرْكِهِ دُخُولَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ،
en: and Thou hast threatened that the refraining from it would yield entrance into Gehenna in utter abjection.
So they remember Thee for Thy kindness, they thank Thee for Thy bounty,
they supplicate Thee by Thy command,
and they donate for Thee in order to seek Thy increase;
in all this lies their deliverance from Thy wrath
and their triumph through Thy good pleasure.

ar: وَلَوْ دَلَّ مَخْلُوقٌ مَخْلُوقاً مِنْ نَفْسِهِ
en: Were any creature himself to direct another creature

ar: عَلَى مِثْلِ الَّذِيْ دَلَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عِبَادَكَ مِنْكَ
en: to the like of that to which Thou Thyself hast directed Thy servants,
he would be described by beneficence,
qualified by kindness, and praised by every tongue.

ar: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ مَا وُجِدَ فِي حَمْدِكَ مَذْهَبٌ،
en: So to Thee belongs praise as long as there is found a way to praise Thee

ar: وَمَا بَقِيَ لِلْحَمْدِ لَفْظٌ تُحْمَدُ بِهِ وَمَعْنىً يَنْصَرفُ إلَيْهِ
en: and as long as there remains for praising words by which Thou may be praised and meanings which may be spent in praise!

ar: يَـا مَنْ تَحَمَّدَ إلَى عِبَـادِهِ بِالإِحْسَـانِ وَالْفَضْل،
en: O He who shows Himself praiseworthy to His servants through beneficence and bounty,
flooding them with kindness and graciousness!

ar: مَا أَفْشَى فِيْنَا نِعْمَتَكَ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْنَا مِنَّتَكَ،
en: How much Thy favour has been spread about among us, Thy kindness lavished upon us,
and Thy goodness singled out for us!
Thou hast guided us to Thy religion which Thou hast chosen,
Thy creed with which Thou art pleased,
and Thy path which Thou hast made smooth,

ar: وَبَصَّرْتَنَا الزُّلْفَةَ لَدَيْكَ وَالوُصُولَ إلَى كَـرَامَتِكَ.
en: and Thou hast shown us proximity to Thee and arrival at Thy generosity!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَنْتَ جَعَلْتَ مِنْ صَفَـايَـا تِلْكَ الْوَظَائِفِ
en: O God, Thou hast appointed among the choicest of those duties
and the most special of those obligations

ar: شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي اخْتَصَصْتَهُ مِنْ سَائِرِ الشُّهُورِ،
en: the month of Ramadan, which Thou hast singled out from other months,
chosen from among all periods and eras,
and preferred over all times of the year

ar: بِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ وَالنُّورِ،
en: through the Qur'an and the Light which Thou sent down within it,
the faith which Thou multiplied by means of it,
the fasting which Thou obligated therein,
the standing in prayer which Thou encouraged at its time,
and the Night of Decree which Thou magnified therein,

ar: الَّتِي هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْر،
en: the night which is "better than a thousand months" (97:3).

ar: ثُمَّ آثَرْتَنَا بِهِ عَلَى سَائِرِ الأُمَمِ
en: Through it Thou hast preferred us over the other communities
and through its excellence Thou hast chosen us to the exclusion of the people of the creeds.
We fasted by Thy command in its daylight,
we stood in prayer with Thy help in its night,

ar: مُتَعَرِّضِينَ بِصِيَامِهِ وَقِيَامِهِ لِمَا عَرَّضْتَنَا لَهُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ،
en: presenting ourselves by its fasting and its standing to the mercy which Thou hast held up before us,
and we found through it the means to Thy reward.

ar: وَأَنْتَ الْمَليءُ بِمَا رُغِبَ فِيهِ إلَيْكَ،
en: And Thou art full of what is sought from Thee,
munificent with what is asked of Thy bounty,
and near to him who strives for Thy nearness.

ar: وَقَدْ أَقَامَ فِينَا هَذَا الشَّهْرُ مَقَامَ حَمْد
en: This month stood among us in a standing place of praise,
accompanied us with the companionship of one approved,
and profited us with the most excellent profit of the world's creatures.

ar: ثُمَّ قَدْ فَارَقَنَا عِنْدَ تَمَامِ وَقْتِهِ وَانْقِطَاعِ مُدَّتِهِ وَوَفَاءِ عَدَدِهِ،
en: Then it parted from us at the completion of its time, the end of its term, and the fulfilment of its number.

ar: فَنَحْنُ مُوَدِّعُوهُ وِدَاعَ مَنْ عَزَّ فِرَاقُهُ عَلَيْنَا
en: So we bid farewell to it with the farewell of one whose parting pains us,
whose leaving fills us with gloom and loneliness,
and to whom we have come to owe a safeguarded claim,
an observed inviolability, and a discharged right.
We say: Peace be upon thee,

ar: يَا شَهْرَ اللهِ الأكْبَرَ، وَيَا عِيْدَ أَوْلِيَائِهِ.
en: O greatest month of God! O festival of His friends!

ar: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَـا أكْرَمَ مَصْحُـوب مِنَ الأوْقَاتِ،
en: Peace be upon thee, O most noble of accompanying times!

ar: وَيَا خَيْرَ شَهْر فِي الأيَّامِ وَالسَّاعَاتِ.
en: O best of months in days and hours!

ar: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْر قَرُبَتْ فِيهِ الآمالُ
en: Peace be upon thee, month in which expectations come near
and good works are scattered about!

ar: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ قَرِين جَلَّ قَدْرُهُ مَوْجُوداً،
en: Peace be upon thee, comrade who is great in worth when found

ar: وَأَفْجَعَ فَقْدُهُ مَفْقُوداً، وَمَرْجُوٍّ آلَمَ فِرَاقُهُ.
en: and who torments through absence when lost, anticipated friend whose parting gives pain!

ar: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَلِيف آنَسَ مُقْبِلاً فَسَرَّ
en: Peace be upon thee, familiar who brought comfort in coming, thus making happy,
who left loneliness in going, thus giving anguish!

ar: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ مُجَاوِر رَقَّتْ فِيهِ الْقُلُوبُ، وَقَلَّتْ فِيهِ الذُّنُوبُ.
en: Peace be upon thee, neighbour in whom hearts became tender and sins became few!

ar: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ نَاصِر أَعَانَ عَلَى الشَّيْطَانِ
en: Peace be upon thee, helper who aided against Satan,
companion who made easy the paths of good-doing!

ar: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مَا أكْثَرَ عُتَقَاءَ اللهِ فِيكَ
en: Peace be upon thee - How many became freedmen of God within thee!

ar: وَمَا أَسْعَدَ مَنْ رَعَى حُرْمَتَكَ بكَ!.
en: How happy those who observed the respect due to thee!

ar: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ أَمْحَاكَ لِلذُّنُوبِ،
en: Peace be upon thee - How many the sins thou erased!
How many the kinds of faults thou covered over!

ar: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ أَطْوَلَكَ عَلَى الْمُجْرِمِينَ،
en: Peace be upon thee - How drawn out wert thou for the sinners!
How awesome wert thou in the hearts of the faithful!

ar: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْر لا تُنَافِسُهُ الأيَّامُ.
en: Peace be upon thee, month with which no days compete!

ar: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْر هُوَ مِنْ كُلِّ أَمْر سَلاَمٌ.
en: Peace be upon thee, month which is peace in all affairs!
Peace be upon thee, thou whose companionship is not disliked,
thou whose friendly mixing is not blamed!

ar: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ كَمَا وَفَدْتَ عَلَيْنَا بِالْبَرَكَاتِ،
en: Peace be upon thee, just as thou hast entered upon us with blessings
and cleansed us of the defilement of offenses!
Peace be upon thee - Thou art not bid farewell in annoyance
nor is thy fasting left in weariness!

ar: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ مَطْلُوبِ قَبْلَ وَقْتِهِ
en: Peace be upon thee, object of seeking before thy time,
object of sorrow before thy passing!

ar: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ كَمْ مِنْ سُوء صُرِفَ بِكَ عَنَّا
en: Peace be upon thee - How much evil was turned away from us through thee!

ar: وَكَمْ مِنْ خَيْر أُفِيضَ بِكَ عَلَيْنَا.
en: How much good flowed upon us because of thee!
Peace be upon thee and upon the Night of Decree

ar: الَّتِي هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْر.
en: which is "better than a thousand months" (97:3)!

ar: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ ما كَانَ أَحْرَصَنَا بِالأمْسِ عَلَيْكَ
en: Peace be upon thee - How much we craved thee yesterday!
How intensely we shall yearn for thee tomorrow!

ar: أَلسَلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى فَضْلِكَ الَّذِي حُرِمْنَاهُ ،
en: Peace be upon thee and upon thy bounty which has now been made unlawful to us
and upon thy blessings gone by which have now been stripped away from us!

ar: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّا أَهْلُ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ الِّذِي شَرَّفْتَنَا بِهِ
en: O God, we are the people of this month. Through it Thou hast ennobled us

ar: وَوَفّقتَنَا بِمَنِّكَ لَهُ حِينَ جَهِلَ الاَشْقِيَا وَقْتَهُُ
en: and given us success because of Thy kindness, while the wretched are ignorant of its time.
Made unlawful to them is its bounty because of their wretchedness.

ar: أَنْتَ وَلِيُّ مَا اثَرْتَنَا بِهِ مِنْ مَعْرِفَتِهِ،
en: Thou art the patron of the knowledge of it by which Thou hast preferred us,
and its prescribed practices to which Thou hast guided us.

ar: وَقَدْ تَوَلَّيْنَا بِتَوْفِيقِكَ صِيَامَهُ وَقِيَامَهُ عَلى تَقْصِير،
en: We have undertaken, through Thy giving success, its fasting and its standing in prayer, but with shortcomings,
and we have performed little of much.
O God, so to Thee belongs praise, in admission of evil doing

ar: وَاعْتِرَافاً بِالإضَاعَةِ، وَلَك مِنْ قُلُوبِنَا عَقْدُ النَّدَمِ،
en: and confession of negligence, and to Thee belongs remorse firmly knitted in our hearts
and seeking of pardon sincerely uttered by our tongues.

ar: فَاْجُرْنَا عَلَى مَا أَصَابَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ التَّفْرِيطِ
en: Reward us, in spite of the neglect that befell us in this month,

ar: أَجْرَاً نَسْتَدْركُ بِهِ الْفَضْلَ الْمَرْغُوبَ فِيهِ،
en: with a reward through which we may reach the bounty desired from it

ar: وَنَعْتَاضُ بِهِ مِنْ أَنْوَاعِ الذُّخْرِ الْمَحْرُوصِ عَلَيْهِ ،
en: and win the varieties of its craved stores!

ar: وَأَوْجِبْ لَنَا عُذْرَكَ عَلَى مَا قَصَّرْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ حَقِّكَ،
en: Make incumbent upon us Thy pardon for our falling short of Thy right in this month

ar: وَابْلُغْ بِأَعْمَارِنَا مَا بَيْنَ أَيْديْنَا مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ الْمُقْبِلِ،
en: and make our lives which lie before us reach the coming month of Ramadan!
Once Thou hast made us reach it, help us perform
the worship of which Thou art worthy,

ar: وَأَدِّنَا إلَى الْقِيَامِ بِمَا يَسْتَحِقُّهُ مِنَ الطَّاعَةِ
en: cause us to undertake the obedience which Thou deservest,
and grant us righteous works

ar: مَا يَكون دَرَكاً لِحَقِّكَ فِي الشَّهْرَيْنِ مِنْ شُهُورِ الدَّهْرِ.
en: that we may fulfil Thy right in these two months of the months of time.

ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَمَا أَلْمَمْنَا بِهِ فِي شَهْرِنَا هَذَا مِنْ لَمَم أَوْ إثْم،
en: O God, as for the small and large sins which we have committed in this our month,

ar: أَوْ وَاقَعْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ ذَنْبِ وَاكْتَسَبْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ خَطِيئَة
en: the misdeeds into which we have fallen, and the offenses which we have earned

ar: عَلَى تَعَمُّد مِنَّا أو عَلى نِسيانٍ ظَلَمنا فيه أنفُسَنا أَوِ انْتَهَكْنَا بِهِ حُرْمَةً مِنْ غَيْرِنَا
en: purposefully or in forgetfulness, wronging ourselves thereby or violating the respect due to others,

ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاسْتُرْنَا بِسِتْرِكَ،
en: bless Muhammad and his Household, cover us over with Thy covering,
pardon us through Thy pardoning,
place us not before the eyes of the gloaters because of that,

ar: وَلاَ تَبْسُطْ عَلَيْنَا فِيهِ أَلْسُنَ الطَّاعِنينَ،
en: stretch not toward us the tongues of the defamers,
and employ us in that which will alleviate and expiate

ar: لِمَا أَنْكَرْتَ مِنَّا فِيهِ بِرَأْفَتِكَ الَّتِي لاَ تَنْفَدُ،
en: whatever Thou disapprovest from us within it through Thy clemency which does not run out,
and Thy bounty which does not diminish!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
redress our being afflicted by our month,
bless us in this day of our festival and our fast-breaking,

ar: وَاجْعَلْهُ مِنْ خَيْرِ يَوْم مَرَّ عَلَيْنَا أَجْلَبِهِ لِعَفْو، وَأَمْحَاهُ لِذَنْبِ،
en: make it one of the best of days that have passed over us, the greatest in attracting Thy pardon, and the most effacing toward sins,

ar: وَاغْفِرْ لَنا ما خَفِيَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِنَا وَمَا عَلَنَ.
en: and forgive us our sins, both the concealed and the public!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ اسلَخْنَا بِانْسِلاَخِ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ مِنْ خَطَايَانَا
en: O God, with the passing of this month make us pass forth from our offenses,
with its departure make us depart from our evil deeds,
and appoint us thereby among its most felicitous people,

ar: وَأَجْزَلِهِمْ قِسَمَاً فِيـهِ وَأَوْفَـرِهِمْ حَظّاً مِنْـهُ.
en: the most plentiful of them in portion, and the fullest of them in share!

ar: أللّهُمَّ وَمَنْ رَعَى حَقّ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهِ
en: O God, when any person observes this month as it should be observed,

ar: وَحَفِظَ حُرْمَتَهُ حَقَّ حِفْظِهَا وَقَامَ بِحُدُودِهِ حَقَّ قِيَامِهَا،
en: safeguards its inviolability as it should be safeguarded, attends to its bounds as they should be attended to,

ar: وَأتَّقَى ذُنُوبَهُ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهَا أَوْ تَقَرَّبَ إلَيْكَ بِقُرْبَة
en: fears its misdeeds as they should be feared, or seeks nearness to Thee with any act of nearness-seeking

ar: أَوْجَبَتْ رِضَاكَ لَهُ وَعَطَفَتْ رَحْمَتَكَ عَلَيْهِ،
en: which makes incumbent upon him Thy good pleasure and bends toward him Thy mercy,
give to us the like [of that] from Thy wealth
and bestow it upon us in multiples through Thy bounty,

ar: فَإنَّ فَضْلَكَ، لا يَغِيْضُ وَإنَّ خَـزَائِنَكَ لا تَنْقُصُ، بَـلْ تَفِيضُ
en: for Thy bounty does not diminish, Thy treasuries do not decrease but overflow,
the mines of Thy beneficence are not exhausted,
and Thy bestowal is the bestowal full of delight!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

ar: وَاكْتُبْ لَنَا مِثْلَ أجُورِ مَنْ صَامَهُ
en: and write for us the like of the wages of him who fasted in it

ar: أَوْ تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ فِيْهِ إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
en: or worshipped Thee within it until the Day of Resurrection!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّا نَتُوبُ إلَيْكَ فِي يَوْمِ فِطْرِنَا
en: O God, we repent to Thee in our day of fast-breaking,
which Thou hast appointed for the faithful a festival and a joy

ar: وَلأِهْلِ مِلَّتِكَ مَجْمَعاً وَمُحْتشداً مِنْ كُلِّ ذَنْب أَذْنَبْنَاهُ،
en: and for the people of Thy creed a time of assembly and gathering, from every misdeed we did,

ar: أَوْ سُوْء أَسْلَفْنَاهُ، أَوْ خَاطِرِ شَرٍّ أَضْمَرْنَاهُ،
en: ill work we sent ahead, or evil thought we secretly conceived,

ar: تَوْبَةَ مَنْ لاَ يَنْطَوِيْ عَلَى رُجُوع إلَى ذَنْب
en: the repentance of one who does not harbour a return to sin
and who afterwards will not go back to offense,

ar: تَوْبَةً نَصوحاً خَلَصَتْ مِنَ الشَّكِّ وَالارْتِيَابِ،
en: an unswerving repentance rid of doubt and wavering.

ar: فَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنَّا وَارْضَ عَنَّا وَثَبِّتنَا عَلَيْهَا.
en: So accept it from us, be pleased with us, and fix us within it!
God, provide us with fear of the threatened punishment

ar: وَشَوْقَ ثَوَابِ الْمَوْعُودِ حَتّى نَجِدَ لَذَّةَ مَا نَدْعُوكَ بِهِ،
en: and yearning for the promised reward, so that we may find the pleasure of that for which we supplicate Thee
and the sorrow of that from which we seek sanctuary in Thee!

ar: وَاجْعَلْنَا عِنْدَكَ مِنَ التَّوَّابِيْنَ الَّذِينَ أَوْجَبْتَ لَهُمْ مَحَبَّتَكَ،
en: And place us with Thee among the repenters, those upon whom Thou hast made Thy love obligatory

ar: وَقَبِلْتَ مِنْهُمْ مُرَاجَعَةَ طَاعَتِكَ، يَا أَعْدَلَ الْعَادِلِينَ.
en: and from whom Thou hast accepted the return to obeying Thee! O Most Just of the just!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ تَجَاوَزْ عَنْ آبآئِنَا وَأُمَّهَاتِنَا وَأَهْلِ دِيْنِنَا جَمِيعاً
en: O God, show forbearance toward our fathers and our mothers and all the people of our religion,

ar: مَنْ سَلَفَ مِنْهُمْ وَمَنْ غَبَرَ إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
en: those who have gone and those who will pass by, until the Day of Resurrection!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد نَبِيِّنَا وَآلِهِ،
en: O God, bless our prophet Muhammad and his Household,
as Thou hast blessed Thy angels brought nigh,
bless him and his Household,
as Thou hast blessed Thy prophets sent out,

ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ،
en: bless him and his Household, as Thou hast blessed Thy righteous servants

ar: وَأَفْضَلَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ،
en: - and better than that, O Lord of the worlds!
a blessing whose benediction will reach us, whose benefit will attain to us,
and through which our supplication may be granted!
Thou art the most generous of those who are beseeched,
the most sufficient of those in whom confidence is had,
the most bestowing of those from whom bounty is asked,
and Thou art powerful over everything!
